fuzz.about: A differential fuzz of the heading path (U35, decided 2026-10-04): renderMarkdown() and headings() of wc085/int c8e4b23 (lib/core/markdown.js unchanged since 29228ee, so before the chat flavour) over seeded random strings of #, space, tab, x and newline, odd cases led by 1-7 hashes and a blank. Each digest is the first 10 hex of sha256(JSON.stringify([renderMarkdown(s), headings(s)])); test/markdown-chat.test.js regenerates the inputs with the same generator (fuzzInputs there) and compares. Never regenerate it to make a test pass.
